records.subject: Welcome aboard, Bright Logistics
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Glad to have Bright Logistics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone despite a held onboarding call [calendar:f341f451] and three Wrenfield emails with no customer replies [email:cd62cd8c][email:adbba51a]. Engagement so far is support-driven (badge bug, VAT invoice ticket) rather than product use, so unaided activation in 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Your VAT invoice question, and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for raising the VAT invoice question -- that ticket is still open on our side and we'll follow up as soon as we have an answer for you. A VAT number can be added to invoices from billing settings, so we'll make sure yours is reflected correctly.

In the meantime, the piece that usually makes everything else click is getting one real project in place -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and your actual work.

Best,
Chidi
